09 / 09 · The Classroom Coach Teacher Aid Programme

Teacher Aid

Bring professional coaches into your classroom. We place trained Proteus coaches in schools as teacher aids to support teachers, engage students and bring energy, structure and mentorship to the school day.

Talk about classroom support
THE PROTEUS WAY / CLASSROOM COACHES

WHO IT’S FOR

Schools that need extra adult support in the classroom, positive role models, or flexible staffing for busy classes.

01

Support for teachers

Help with classroom management, small groups, transitions and students who need extra attention, without replacing the teacher.

02

Positive role models

Coaches experienced in youth leadership, positive behaviour and social-emotional development, reinforcing your school’s values.

03

We handle the staffing

Carefully selected and vetted coaches, with Proteus managing matching, coordination and ongoing support.

How it works

  • 01 · Reach out to discuss your needs
  • 02 · We match the right coach
  • 03 · Your coach joins the classroom
  • 04 · We stay involved with ongoing support

HERE TO HELP

QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
Do your coaches replace the teacher?

No. They support teachers with classroom management, small groups, transitions and students who need extra attention.

How are coaches chosen?

Coaches are carefully selected and vetted. Proteus manages matching, coordination and ongoing support.

How do we get started?

Reach out to discuss your needs. We match the right coach, your coach joins the classroom, and we stay involved with ongoing support.

How can our school or club work with Proteus?

Contact patrick@proteus.nz with your organisation, the sport or activity, the group you want to support and your goals. We can discuss coaching and programme options that fit your needs.
